note: Real, dated export shipments are confirmed by customs/B-L records with HS codes and BOL numbers — the company is an active exporter of textile machinery parts, static-elimination/printing equipment and machinery parts to Vietnam, Germany, Saudi Arabia, UAE and the Netherlands. Declared HS 844399 (parts of printing machinery) does not match the observed shipment HS codes (84482000, 85030010, 84796000, 90329000, 84159000, 85437099, 84139190); per project rules this is not a rejection ground — the company stays in the base and the HS code should be corrected to the actual observed codes. Role appears to be manufacturer_trader (mixed own-brand equipment plus third-party machinery parts). Revenue and export volume figures are not public in the sources read — null, not estimated. Domestic (India) supply activity could not be verified from public sources in this session; no claim of domestic supply is made.
